name: supervisor
description: SUBAGENT SUPERVISOR: routing-and-budget Mod. Rewrites a spawn's model onto the capability graph instead of denying it, keeps a measured per-agent-type token ledger in $.store, caps tool calls per subagent, and shows live subagents + the last routing decision above the prompt. /supervisor prints the routing log and the ledger.

maxSubagentCalls.title: Max tool calls per subagent
maxSubagentCalls.description: A subagent that exceeds this many tool calls has its further calls denied by the supervisor.
